name: tradingview-mcp
description: MCP bridge for TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol

scripts.start: npm run start:env & npm run webhook & npm run ngrok:webhook
scripts.launch: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const p=process.platform; const script = p === 'darwin' ? 'launch:mac' : p === 'linux' ? 'launch:linux' : 'launch:windows'; const npm = p === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const status = spawnSync(npm, ['run', script], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status; process.exit(status == null ? 0 : status);"
scripts.ngrok:auth: node --env-file=.env -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const token = process.env.NGROK_TOKEN; if (!token) { console.error('Set NGROK_TOKEN before running npm run ngrok:auth.'); process.exit(1); } const child = spawnSync('ngrok', ['config', 'add-authtoken', token], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(typeof child.status === 'number' ? child.status : 0);"
scripts.ngrok:webhook: node --env-file=.env -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const port = process.env.TV_WEBHOOK_PORT || '8787'; const child = spawn('ngrok', ['http', port], { stdio: 'inherit' }); child.on('error', (error) => { console.error('Failed to start ngrok:', error.message); process.exit(1); }); child.on('exit', (code) => { process.exit(code ?? 0); });"
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/pine_analyze.test.js tests/cli.test.js tests/sanitization.test.js tests/replay.test.js tests/launch.test.js tests/chart_indicator.test.js tests/chart_history.test.js tests/update.test.js tests/watchlist_import.test.js tests/alerts.test.js tests/webhook.test.js tests/trading.test.js
scripts.test:all: node --test tests/e2e.test.js tests/pine_analyze.test.js tests/cli.test.js tests/sanitization.test.js tests/replay.test.js tests/launch.test.js tests/chart_indicator.test.js tests/chart_history.test.js tests/update.test.js tests/watchlist_import.test.js tests/alerts.test.js tests/webhook.test.js tests/trading.test.js
